title: Baobab Market Registry
description: Commercial operating contexts that are not synonymous with country, region, or estate. A market is a business-defined operational boundary (§11, §22, §30).

marketId.description: Opaque market identifier. Examples: south-africa-b2b, kenya-wholesale, east-africa-distributor.

canonical_key.description: Immutable business key identifying the market in external references and events.

owner_tenant_id.description: Control Plane tenant that owns this market.

legal_entity_id.description: Primary legal entity responsible for this market's operations.

operating_region_id.description: Broader geographic or operational region that may contain this market.

parent_market_id.description: Optional reference to parent market in a hierarchy (§11.3). Parent can supply configuration defaults.

default_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 primary country code for this market (if country-specific).

countries.description: List of ISO country codes where this market operates. A market may span multiple countries; a country may have multiple markets.

default_currency.description: ISO 4217 default transaction currency for this market.

allowed_currencies.description: ISO 4217 currencies permitted for transactions in this market (§31).

accounting_context.description: Reference to accounting configuration (e.g., account structure, consolidation rules).

default_locale.description: BCP 47 default locale for content and communication (§32).

supported_locales.description: BCP 47 locales supported for this market. Fallback chain should be explicit (§32).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for market operations (e.g., Africa/Johannesburg, Africa/Nairobi).

tax_profile_id.description: Reference to applicable tax configuration and rates.

pricing_policy_id.description: Reference to market-specific pricing rules and policies.

catalogue_policy_id.description: Reference to product catalogue composition and availability rules for this market.

payment_policy_id.description: Reference to accepted payment methods and providers.

fulfilment_policy_id.description: Reference to warehousing and delivery strategy.

regulatory_profile_id.description: Reference to regulatory requirements (licenses, compliance, data residency).

effective_from.description: Market becomes operational at this timestamp.

effective_to.description: Market ceases operation at this timestamp (if retiring).

marketHierarchy.description: Market hierarchy for inheritance of configuration defaults (§11.3, §20).
